name: apply_damage
description:
Applies damage to a character or NPC with automatic resistance/immunity/vulnerability resolution. Always pass the raw dice roll — do not pre-adjust for resistances. Temporary HP absorbs damage after resistances are applied. HP floors at 0.

Automatic side effects when a character drops to 0 HP: the Unconscious condition is applied (unless immune), death saves begin, and any active concentration spell is broken. Instant death occurs if the excess damage equals or exceeds the target's maximum HP.

When a concentrating entity takes HP damage but survives above 0 HP, the response includes the required Constitution save DC (max(10, ceil(hp_lost/2))).

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a player character or an NPC.

entity.description: The slug or UUID of the character or NPC to damage.

amount.description: The raw damage amount before resistances (i.e., the dice roll total). Do not halve or double it — the server applies the correct multiplier.

damage_type.description: The type of damage (e.g., Fire, Slashing, Necrotic). Must match the values stored in the target's damage_resistances, damage_immunities, or damage_vulnerabilities. If omitted, no multiplier is applied.
